description: Search the Catalunya 2022 - RESET policy document by keyword. Returns up to 10 results with canonical slugs (for follow-up with get_section) and text snippets; "total" carries the full match count. Terms are matched independently with coverage-based ranking; quoted phrases ("energia sostenible") must match exactly. Handles Catalan/Spanish diacritics automatically (e.g., 'educacio' matches 'educació').

locale.description: Content language. Defaults to 'ca' (Catalan), the original language of the document. (ca=Catalan, en=English, es=Spanish)

query.description: Search query (e.g., 'housing', 'educacio', 'digital transformation'). Use terms in the target locale for best results.

scope.description: Filter by section type: 'action' (91 proposals), 'goal' (12 overviews), 'sphere' (3 overviews), or 'static' (introduction, executive summary, train of prosperity)

name: search_document

message.description: Guidance when no results were found

goalId.description: Present on goal and action results

slug.description: Canonical section slug, usable with get_section

sphereId.description: Present on sphere, goal, and action results

url.description: Canonical page URL on 2022.cat in the requested locale

title: Search the document
